correctness.rationale: Each full-branch skew tent preserves Lebesgue: inverse branch derivatives a and 1-a sum to one, so uniform initial law is annealed stationary. On centered polynomial u=x-1/2,v=x²-x+1/6, exact branch expansion gives P_a u=(2a-1)u and P_a v=[1-3a(1-a)]v-a(1-a)u. Thus annealed P has triangular matrix [[r,-q],[0,s]], q>0; its Jordan condition is r=s, precisely 3EA²-5m+2=0. Jensen q<=m(1-m) implies m>=2/3 and strict m<1. With h=u+v and orthogonal moments ∫u²=1/12, ∫v²=1/180, ∫uv=0, transfer duality yields the stated exact all-n covariance. At resonance geometric convolution becomes nλ^(n-1); divide by Var(X²)=4/45 to obtain λ^n(1-5(1-m)n/(8λ)). For the two-atom law m=3/4,q=1/6,λ=1/2, sign first reverses at n=4. Checked polynomial diagonal coefficient d_k for k>=3 is strictly below λ because a^(k+1)+(-1)^k(1-a)^(k+1)<a³+(1-a)³ pointwise. Independently symbolically expanded P_a u,P_a v and verified 25 rational-lag identities for two-atom covariance, including n=0. No full Banach-space resonance implied.
